Name: Wynter's Haley Portraits
Author: wyntxrr
Description:
[center]This is a portrait mod that replaces Haley's portraits with highly detailed portraits created by me.

This is a Content Patcher mod, so just unzip the downloaded file and drop it into your mods folder.

Note: this mod does require the HD Portraits mod and AeroCore.

Portraits for other characters may be coming soon.
